summary: Tidewater Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 21, 2026 it entered a Guarantee Agreement with Brazilian development bank BNDES, guaranteeing full and timely payment of obligations under five BNDES Construction Loans originated between 2007 and 2012 to subsidiary Tidewater do Brasil S.A. (formerly Wilson Sons Offshore). The guarantee is unsecured, ranks pari passu with other unsecured obligations, and replaces guarantees from Wilson Sons and Remolcadores Ultratug; documentation to release those guarantors is pending. This is a routine credit-support contract, not a special situation; watch any material change in guaranteed exposure or collateral terms.
